title: New annotations API always sets TimeEnd (point == range convention)
answers: Why does a point annotation now have TimeEnd set instead of null?
What should TimeEnd be for a point annotation created via the new API?
How is a point vs range annotation represented in storage now?
Annotation backfill/migration leaves TimeEnd null for points - is that still correct?
body: Invariant: in the new annotations API, every annotation must have a non-null TimeEnd; for point annotations TimeEnd == Time (previously TimeEnd was left nil for points). Enforced on create in pkg/registry/apps/annotation/k8s_adapter.go:k8sRESTAdapter.Create (defaults TimeEnd to Time when the client omits it) and on legacy-data backfill in pkg/registry/apps/annotation/migrator/convert.go:toBackfillRecord (now always sets TimeEnd = max(EpochEnd, Epoch) instead of leaving it nil when EpochEnd <= Epoch). This is step 1 of enabling a single time_end index for range queries (NOT NULL constraint and dropping the points/ranges UNION in List is a planned follow-up) - don't reintroduce nil-TimeEnd writes for points, and don't assume TimeEnd==nil means 'no end time' when reading/migrating data going forward.
applies: New annotations API (pkg/registry/apps/annotation/*) and its legacy-data migrator; anywhere annotation Time/TimeEnd are written or classified as point vs range.
says: When I create a point annotation, why is the end time always set?
Point annotations now store an end time same as their start time?
How are point versus range annotations stored differently now?
Why do migrated legacy point annotations leave the end time empty?
Old point annotations lack end times but new ones must have them?
search: The new annotations API enforces that every annotation must have a non-null TimeEnd field, with the convention that point annotations have TimeEnd == Time (not nil as before). This is enforced on create in pkg/registry/apps/annotation/k8s_adapter.go:k8sRESTAdapter.Create (which defaults TimeEnd to Time when clients omit it) and on legacy-data backfill in pkg/registry/apps/annotation/migrator/convert.go:toBackfillRecord (which now always sets TimeEnd = max(EpochEnd, Epoch) instead of leaving it nil). The invariant enables a planned single time_end index for range queries and is a step toward a NOT NULL constraint that will drop the points/ranges UNION in List operations. Do not reintroduce nil-TimeEnd writes for point annotations, and do not assume TimeEnd==nil means 'no end time' when reading or migrating annotation data going forward. Applies to the new annotations API and its legacy-data migrator wherever annotation Time/TimeEnd are written or classified as point vs range.
